definitions.short: an eyelash (as fluttering); figuratively, morning ray
definitions.full: H6079. aphaph [ עַפְעַף ] noun masculine Jer 9:17 eyelid (Late Hebrew id. ; from fluttering ?); — only dual construct (see below) and suffix עַפְעַמַּי Job 16:16 ; Psa 132:4 , עַפְעַמֶּיךָ Prov 4:25 ; 6:4 , etc.; — eyelids , usually nearly = eyes (6 t. || עֵינַיִם ), as weeping, עַפְעַמֵּינוּ Jer 9:17 ; closed in sleep Psa 132:4 ; Prov 6:4 , compare of צַלְמָוֶת Job 16:16 ; looking Prov 4:25 compare Psa 11:4 (of ׳י , testing men); used seductively by wanton women Prov 6:25 ; raised, in arrogance ( ' superciliousness ' 30:13 ; figurative עַפְעַמֵּישָֿׁ֑חַר Job 3:9 eyelids of dawn , break of dawn, 41:10 (simile).
